Riley (PM): Quick design callout 0m: regression diff visibility & compactness toggle for eval runs. We need a defensible default for teams that triage lots of small diffs. Thoughts?
Harper (Design): Default to compact diff list for run overview (smaller rows, inline diff snippet) and keep a persistent "Open full diff" CTA per test. For quick triage, users want density + clear affordance to expand.
Owen (Product): Data: power users open ~6 items per run on avg. New users open ~1-2. So default compact helps power users, but we should respect user preference with a persisted toggle.
Kai (Eng): Implementation: add `pref=diff_view:compact|expanded` in user settings (local storage + backend opt-in). Quick toggle in header with label "Diff view: Compact | Expanded". We'll expose `data-qa=diff-view-toggle`.
Nia (A11y): Accessibility: toggles and expand controls must be keyboard operable and announce state: use `role=\"switch\" aria-checked=\"true|false\"` and update a polite live region: "Diff view set to Compact". Avoid repeating content changes for screen readers unless requested.
Harper (Design): Visual: compact rows show first 120 chars of output + small inline diff glyph. Expanded shows full unified diff with side-by-side option. Add small preview popover on hover/focus: pressing `space` or `Enter` when focused should open preview.
Riley (PM): Good. Also want a "Focus failing tests" filter in the header that toggles the list to failing-only. Combine with diff view and remember the combination per user.
Owen (Product): Copy: CTA for bulk operations should be explicit: "Approve visible tests (filtered: Failing only)". People forget filters and accidentally approve non-visible tests otherwise.
Kai (Eng): Backend note: bulk approve receives a list of IDs computed from current filter+sort+page. We'll surface an inline confirmation modal listing count and a short sample diff snippet to reduce accidental approvals. Add `data-qa=bulk-approve-confirm`.
Nia (A11y): For the confirmation modal, move focus into modal, ensure `aria-modal=true` and announce via assertive live region: "Approving 8 tests. This will update baselines." Provide keyboard cancel with `Esc`.
Harper (Design): Microcopy nit: avoid verbs 'Approve' alone. Use 'Approve & update baseline' for any action that writes baselines, and 'Mark reviewed' for non-destructive. Keep CTA width reasonable — truncate in small view but show tooltip with full phrase.
Riley (PM): UX safety: add an undo snackbar after bulk approve: "Baselines updated for 8 tests. Undo". Undo window 10 minutes. Also show per-run activity in header with small progress spinner and `role=status`.
Kai (Eng): Ops note: bulk approve triggers background job; we'll return optimistic UI and then replace with actual status once job completes. ops-bot will post status updates in-thread: `ops-bot: baseline job for run 998 queued (ETA ~40s)`. We'll add event telemetry for approve_type (inline|bulk|modal).
ops-bot: baseline job for run 998 queued 9 ETA ~40s.
Nia (A11y): Snackbar must not steal focus; use `role=status` and allow keyboard focusable Undo button. Also ensure color-only indicators have text equivalents and high contrast (>=4.5:1).
Harper (Design): Badge colors: pass=green #107C10, fail=red #B91C1C, neutral=gray #6B6B6B. I'll run contrast check and tweak.
Owen (Product): One more: when compact mode hides context, show a small chevron per row to expand inline (not navigate away). That helps reviewers keep flow.
Kai (Eng): We'll implement expand/collapse via `aria-expanded` on the row control and load expanded content lazily. Add `data-qa=row-expand` and `data-qa=row-collapse`.
Riley (PM): Action items: Harper to update Figma with compact+expanded states + sample bulk confirm modal; Owen to draft exact copy for tooltips, bulk modal, and undo snackbar; Kai to add QA hooks and pref plumbing; Nia to validate SR announcements and focus flow. Target: design review next Tues.
Harper (Design): Uploaded Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/diff-compactness-toggle 0 comments enabled.
Owen (Product): I'll paste copy into figma comments by EOD.
Kai (Eng): Will stub data-qa attrs in feature branch and add e2e placeholders.
Nia (A11y): Will run a screen-reader walkthrough after mocks are updated and flag any focus traps.
Riley (PM): Thanks all 1. Closing here.
